blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَائِشَة ﵂ قَالَتْ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَلْمَاهِرُ بِالْقُرْآنِ مَعَ السَّفَرَةِ الْكِرَامِ الْبَرَرَةِ وَالَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَيَتَتَعْتَعُ فِيهِ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِ شَاقٌّ لَهُ أَجْرَانِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب فضل الماهر بالقران والذي يتتعتع فيه رقم:١٨٦٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Aishah (RA) narrated that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “The person who is skilled in memorising the Qur'an and skilled in reciting it will, tomorrow on the Day of the Hereafter, be raised with the angels who write the Qur'an from the tablet called “Lawh al-Mahfuz”; and the one who recites the Qur'an stammering and takes on difficulty in it receives a double reward.”

blocks.text:
Explanation: The one who recites stammering may be a Hafiz who has not memorised the Qur'an properly and is engaged in the effort to remember it, and he may also be one who stammers while reciting by looking; but he must be one who strives to recite correctly. Such a person has two rewards: one reward for reciting, and another reward for bearing the difficulty caused by continually stammering.
(Tibi, Mirqat)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: يَجِيءُ صَاحِبُ الْقُرْآنِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيَقُولُ: يَارَبِّ حَلِّهِ فَيُلْبَسُ تَاجُ الْكَرَامَةِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: يَارَبِّ زِدْهُ فَيُلْبَسُ حُلَّةُ الْكَرَامَةِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: يَارَبِّ إِرْضَ عَنْهُ فَيَرْضَي عَنْهُ فَيُقَالُ لَهُ اِقْرَأْ وَارْقَ وَيُزَادُ بِكُلِّ آيَةٍ حَسَنَةٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن صحيح باب ان الذي ليس في جوفه من القران كالبيت الخرب رقم:٢٩١٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “On the Day of Qiyamah, when the companion of the Qur'an comes (into the presence of Allah), the holy Qur'an will ask Allah to clothe him. From Allah's side the crown of honour will be placed on him; again it will say, “O Lord!
